我们总在拼命讨好别人
we keep trying so hard to please others,
afraid of being misunderstood, of being disliked,
and you think about it all night.
你反复想自己哪里说错了
and you keep wondering what you said wrong.
You don't want to say yes,
but you hear yourself say, "It's fine."
一切烦恼都来自人际关系
all our troubles come from relationships.
就像你可以把马牵到河边
You can lead a horse to water,
but you can't make it drink.
你能做的，只是做好自己
All you can do is be yourself, fully.
Whether others like it or not
You don't need everyone to like you —
而是你开始按自己的方式活着
it means you've started living your own way.
is the courage to be disliked.
